comments.text:
What Sets the office apart:
The Institute for Advanced Dentistry is a specialty practice focused primarily on two areas: Cosmetic Dentistry & Smile Makeovers, and Dental Implants & Teeth in a Day. What makes our office different is the combination of advanced specialty training, comprehensive treatment planning, surgical expertise, cosmetic dentistry, digital technology, and the ability to control every detail of a patient's treatment from the initial design through the final result.
Our practice has a history dating back to 1954 and is recognized as Arizona's first prosthodontic practice. Today, it is led by Dr. Jonathan Bensoussan, a surgically trained prosthodontist, Kois-trained clinician, and Kois Specialty Graduate. Dr. Bensoussan has been treating patients since 2015, giving him more than a decade of hands-on clinical experience focused increasingly on complex cosmetic, restorative, and implant dentistry.

Cosmetic Dentistry & Smile Makeovers

One of Dr. Bensoussan's primary areas of focus is porcelain veneers, cosmetic crowns, smile makeovers, and full-mouth rehabilitation.
Dr. Bensoussan has completed smile transformations for [X+ patients] using porcelain veneers, crowns, implant restorations, and comprehensive restorative treatment.
Our approach to cosmetic dentistry is much more comprehensive than simply making teeth whiter or changing their shape. Each smile is designed around the patient's face, lips, tooth position, tooth proportions, gum architecture, smile line, speech, bite, and function.
For many veneer and crown cases, we digitally design the smile and fabricate 3D-printed esthetic provisional restorations. This allows the patient to actually wear and experience the proposed smile before the final ceramics are made. We can evaluate and refine tooth shape, length, proportions, speech, bite, and esthetics during the provisional phase rather than leaving those decisions until the final restorations return from the laboratory.
Cosmetic Dentistry Statistics
    500+ smile makeovers completed
    4000+ veneer and crown cases completed
    100% patient satisfaction 
    Advanced focus on porcelain veneers, cosmetic crowns, smile makeovers, and full-mouth reconstruction

Dental Implants & Teeth in a Day

Dr. Bensoussan's second major area of focus is dental implant surgery and restoration, particularly complex implant dentistry and Teeth in a Day / All-on-X fixed implant bridges.
Dr. Bensoussan has placed more than 2,500 dental implants, ranging from single-tooth implants to complete full-arch reconstruction.
One of our strongest differentiators is that the surgical and restorative portions of implant treatment can be managed by the same prosthodontist. Dr. Bensoussan designs the final teeth first and then plans the implants around the position required to create the desired final smile, bite, and function.
Implant Statistics
    2,800+ dental implants placed
    98% verified implant survival rate
    Extensive experience with single implants, complex implant rehabilitation, failed implant treatment, and full-arch Teeth in a Day cases
    Same-day fixed provisional teeth available for appropriate full-arch implant patients

What Really Sets Our Treatment Planning Apart

One of the most important differences between our office and many traditional dental practices is who is actually designing the case.
In many dental offices, complicated cases are heavily dependent on the dental laboratory or are divided among several specialists. The dentist may prepare the teeth, take an impression or scan, and rely on the laboratory to determine much of the final tooth design. Similarly, implant patients may see one doctor for surgery, another doctor for restorative treatment, and a laboratory that is receiving instructions from multiple providers.
Our philosophy is different.
Dr. Bensoussan personally develops the diagnosis, treatment plan, smile design, restorative design, bite, implant positioning, provisional restorations, and final restorative objectives.
We use several exceptional dental laboratories, but we intentionally select different laboratories based on their individual strengths. The laboratory executes Dr. Bensoussan's treatment design—not the other way around.
The lab receives detailed direction regarding tooth position, proportions, contours, shade, surface texture, gingival architecture, occlusion, and restorative objectives. This gives Dr. Bensoussan significantly more control over the final result and allows each laboratory technician to contribute his or her craftsmanship within an already carefully developed clinical plan.
That distinction is especially important in smile makeovers, full-mouth reconstruction, and complex implant cases, where small decisions regarding tooth position, bite, implant placement, and esthetics can dramatically affect the final result.

Specialty & Advanced Training

Dr. Bensoussan completed an additional three-year specialty residency in Prosthodontics at UCSF after dental school, with advanced education in:
    Cosmetic and restorative dentistry
    Dental implant surgery and restoration
    Porcelain veneers and complex ceramics
    Full-mouth reconstruction
    Occlusion and bite rehabilitation
    Complex treatment planning
    Esthetics
    Fixed and removable prosthodontics
He has also completed extensive advanced education through the Kois Center and is a Kois Specialty Graduate. The Kois philosophy emphasizes diagnosis, risk assessment, esthetics, occlusion, function, and long-term predictability—principles that are incorporated into how we treatment-plan complex cosmetic and reconstructive cases.

Advanced Digital Technology

The practice uses an integrated digital workflow including:
    3D CBCT imaging
    TRIOS digital intraoral scanning
    Digital Smile Design
    X-Nav / X-Guide dynamic 3D implant navigation
    FastMap photogrammetry
    SprintRay in-office 3D printing
    3D-printed veneer and crown provisional restorations
    Same-day full-arch provisional teeth
    Digital implant planning
    Digital full-mouth rehabilitation planning
The technology itself is not the differentiator. How we use the technology to execute a carefully designed treatment plan is what matters.

Patient Experience & Reputation

Our office is intentionally designed as a high-touch specialty practice rather than a high-volume dental or implant center. We spend significant time diagnosing, treatment planning, educating patients, and refining results.
    85 five-star patient reviews
    5/5 average patient rating
    Extensive patient testimonials and documented smile transformations
    Results-based warranty on qualifying surgical and restorative treatment
    Patients routinely referred by other dentists for advanced restorative, cosmetic, and implant care
    Many patients seek our office after previous dental treatment has failed or when their case has been considered unusually complex

Professional & Community Involvement

Dr. Bensoussan remains actively involved in the Arizona dental community through local dental study clubs, interdisciplinary collaboration, continuing education, and organized dentistry. He participates in study groups with general dentists and specialists throughout Arizona and regularly collaborates with referring dentists on complex restorative and implant patients.
This involvement is particularly important to our philosophy: we want the Institute for Advanced Dentistry to serve not only as a destination for patients, but also as a specialty resource for dentists in the community who encounter complex cosmetic, restorative, and implant cases.

Additional Distinctions

    Practice history dating to 1954
    Recognized as Arizona's first prosthodontic practice
    Dr. Bensoussan has been treating patients since 2015
    Three-year UCSF Prosthodontics specialty residency
    Kois-trained clinician and Kois Specialty Graduate
    2,500+ dental implants placed
    500+ complete smile makeovers performed
    98% verified dental implant survival rate
    85 five-star patient reviews
    Advanced focus on porcelain veneers and smile makeovers
    Advanced focus on Teeth in a Day / full-arch fixed implant bridges
    Expertise in full-mouth reconstruction and complex bite rehabilitation
    Surgical and restorative implant treatment managed under one doctor
    In-office digital smile design and 3D-printed cosmetic provisionals
    Dynamic navigated implant surgery and photogrammetry
    Published research related to prosthodontics and implant complications
    Recognition by Phoenix Magazine as a Top Dentist / Top Prosthodontist for 4 consecutive years
    Fluent in English, French, and Dutch
Ultimately, what sets the Institute for Advanced Dentistry apart is not one technology, one procedure, or one credential. It is that Dr. Bensoussan personally takes ownership of the design and execution of complex dentistry.
Whether the patient wants a beautiful smile transformation with porcelain veneers or requires an entirely new set of fixed teeth with dental implants, we begin by determining exactly what the final result should look like, how it should function, and how it should last. We then use our specialty training, technology, surgical capabilities, provisional restorations, and carefully selected laboratory partners to execute that vision.

The goal is for the website to position the Institute for Advanced Dentistry primarily as a destination for advanced implant dentistry, full-mouth rehabilitation, cosmetic dentistry, and complex prosthodontic care, rather than trying to appear as a general dental office that offers every possible procedure.

Dr. Bensoussan designs the final teeth first and then plans the implants around the position required to create the desired final smile, bite, and function.
Implant Statistics
    2,800+ dental implants placed
    98% verified implant survival rate
    Extensive experience with single implants, complex implant rehabilitation, failed implant treatment, and full-arch Teeth in a Day cases
    Same-day fixed provisional teeth available for appropriate full-arch implant patients

What Really Sets Our Treatment Planning Apart

One of the most important differences between our office and many traditional dental practices is who is actually designing the case.
In many dental offices, complicated cases are heavily dependent on the dental laboratory or are divided among several specialists. The dentist may prepare the teeth, take an impression or scan, and rely on the laboratory to determine much of the final tooth design. Similarly, implant patients may see one doctor for surgery, another doctor for restorative treatment, and a laboratory that is receiving instructions from multiple providers.
Our philosophy is different.
Dr. Bensoussan personally develops the diagnosis, treatment plan, smile design, restorative design, bite, implant positioning, provisional restorations, and final restorative objectives.
We use several exceptional dental laboratories, but we intentionally select different laboratories based on their individual strengths. The laboratory executes Dr. Bensoussan's treatment design—not the other way around.
The lab receives detailed direction regarding tooth position, proportions, contours, shade, surface texture, gingival architecture, occlusion, and restorative objectives. This gives Dr. Bensoussan significantly more control over the final result and allows each laboratory technician to contribute his or her craftsmanship within an already carefully developed clinical plan.
That distinction is especially important in smile makeovers, full-mouth reconstruction, and complex implant cases, where small decisions regarding tooth position, bite, implant placement, and esthetics can dramatically affect the final result.

Specialty & Advanced Training

Dr. Bensoussan completed an additional three-year specialty residency in Prosthodontics at UCSF after dental school, with advanced education in:
    Cosmetic and restorative dentistry
    Dental implant surgery and restoration
    Porcelain veneers and complex ceramics
    Full-mouth reconstruction
    Occlusion and bite rehabilitation
    Complex treatment planning
    Esthetics
    Fixed and removable prosthodontics
He has also completed extensive advanced education through the Kois Center and is a Kois Specialty Graduate. The Kois philosophy emphasizes diagnosis, risk assessment, esthetics, occlusion, function, and long-term predictability—principles that are incorporated into how we treatment-plan complex cosmetic and reconstructive cases.

Advanced Digital Technology

The practice uses an integrated digital workflow including:
    3D CBCT imaging
    TRIOS digital intraoral scanning
    Digital Smile Design
    X-Nav / X-Guide dynamic 3D implant navigation
    FastMap photogrammetry
    SprintRay in-office 3D printing
    3D-printed veneer and crown provisional restorations
    Same-day full-arch provisional teeth
    Digital implant planning
    Digital full-mouth rehabilitation planning
The technology itself is not the differentiator. How we use the technology to execute a carefully designed treatment plan is what matters.

Patient Experience & Reputation

Our office is intentionally designed as a high-touch specialty practice rather than a high-volume dental or implant center. We spend significant time diagnosing, treatment planning, educating patients, and refining results.
    85 five-star patient reviews
    5/5 average patient rating
    Extensive patient testimonials and documented smile transformations
    Results-based warranty on qualifying surgical and restorative treatment
    Patients routinely referred by other dentists for advanced restorative, cosmetic, and implant care
    Many patients seek our office after previous dental treatment has failed or when their case has been considered unusually complex

Professional & Community Involvement

Dr. Bensoussan remains actively involved in the Arizona dental community through local dental study clubs, interdisciplinary collaboration, continuing education, and organized dentistry. He participates in study groups with general dentists and specialists throughout Arizona and regularly collaborates with referring dentists on complex restorative and implant patients.
This involvement is particularly important to our philosophy: we want the Institute for Advanced Dentistry to serve not only as a destination for patients, but also as a specialty resource for dentists in the community who encounter complex cosmetic, restorative, and implant cases.

Additional Distinctions

    Practice history dating to 1954
    Recognized as Arizona's first prosthodontic practice
    Dr. Bensoussan has been treating patients since 2015
    Three-year UCSF Prosthodontics specialty residency
    Kois-trained clinician and Kois Specialty Graduate
    2,500+ dental implants placed
    500+ complete smile makeovers performed
    98% verified dental implant survival rate
    85 five-star patient reviews
    Advanced focus on porcelain veneers and smile makeovers
    Advanced focus on Teeth in a Day / full-arch fixed implant bridges
    Expertise in full-mouth reconstruction and complex bite rehabilitation
    Surgical and restorative implant treatment managed under one doctor
    In-office digital smile design and 3D-printed cosmetic provisionals
    Dynamic navigated implant surgery and photogrammetry
    Published research related to prosthodontics and implant complications
    Recognition by Phoenix Magazine as a Top Dentist / Top Prosthodontist for 4 consecutive years
    Fluent in English, French, and Dutch
Ultimately, what sets the Institute for Advanced Dentistry apart is not one technology, one procedure, or one credential. It is that Dr. Bensoussan personally takes ownership of the design and execution of complex dentistry.
Whether the patient wants a beautiful smile transformation with porcelain veneers or requires an entirely new set of fixed teeth with dental implants, we begin by determining exactly what the final result should look like, how it should function, and how it should last. We then use our specialty training, technology, surgical capabilities, provisional restorations, and carefully selected laboratory partners to execute that vision.
